en: Colorized historic street view showing a busy tram-lined avenue with horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians in formal early-20th‑century clothing. Tall townhouses and ornate facades line both sides of the street. In the distance stands a church or clock tower with an onion-shaped dome. The lower margin contains printed captions and a date, and there is a round archive or postal stamp.
